repair_notes.sources: Consulted Woodruff, Sketching as a Tool for Numerical Linear Algebra, §2.1, complete Definitions 1–2 and the intervening basis discussion (PDF pp. 10–11, printed pp. 9–10; lines 317–370). Definition 1 uses squared norms on a column space, and Definition 2 gives a distribution guarantee for each fixed matrix. Its d counts columns; the repository instead explicitly uses the dimension of a subspace, which lies in integer [0,n]. The complex case and zero-dimensional observation here follow directly from the stated norm formula and finite-dimensional linear algebra, not from a claimed complex or zero-dimensional source theorem.
